_comment: Payment links. Each line below is the web address of a Stripe payment link — the page Stripe hosts where somebody actually types their card details. Create the links in the Stripe dashboard and paste the addresses here; see PAYMENTS.md in the main folder for step-by-step instructions. A line left empty simply hides that button on the website, so it is safe to add them one at a time. Nothing secret belongs in this file: these addresses are meant to be public.
